name: branch8-jira-check
description: At every Claude Code session start: shows which Claude account the session uses and warns when a non-organisation account works on a company project; checks the Jira connection and Jira account; records which Jira project each folder belongs to (folders inherit the nearest record, no git needed) and suggests a dedicated folder plus migrating files when working from a catch-all folder; asks for a Jira ticket on each new task and creates one if there is none. Settings in config.env. Adds /jira-check, /jira-board and /jira-migrate.
